title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 2 dataset
description: A 256-channel EEG dataset from 11 healthy subjects performing an SSVEP-based brain-computer interface protocol. Participants focused on one of five violet boxes flickering simultaneously at 6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00 and 12.00 Hz, with EEG recorded on an EGI 300 Geodesic system at 250 Hz. The dataset supports comparative evaluation of filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction, feature selection and classification algorithms for SSVEP-based BCIs.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System (GES 300) and a 256-channel HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net at 250 Hz, referenced to Cz. Stimuli were flickering boxes on a 22-inch LCD monitor at 60 Hz. Each 5 s flickering window, with the target box cued by an arrow, was followed by 5 s of rest. Each subject completed one adaptation period followed by up to five sessions.
